tool_args.rationale: The pilot horizons already bracket the target of 0.45, so horizon coverage is not the main uncertainty. The history gap and transient lag favor a coupled memory state. A fine trajectory batch is the targeted measurement for separating its relaxation time from its influence on the forecast.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the coupled memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five forecast endpoints with the same history sampling schedule provide limited leverage to separate the memory time constant from the coupling strength.
The cheaper probe is not specified to add the time-resolved trajectories needed to distinguish memory relaxation from direct forcing.

considered_alternatives.option: Single-mode Maxwell decay or Kelvin–Voigt creep
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Neither law represents the observed history gap at matched endpoints. The Maxwell law also predicts negative values for downward steps, whose observed outputs are positive.
